<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_TicketBooking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BookingDetails" name="Booking details and payment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Reminder" name="Pre-travel reminders and instructions"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel company" processRef="Process_TravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BookingDetails" name="Submit booking details" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDetails" targetRef="StartEvent_BookingReceived" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Ticket_Email" name="Email ticket" sourceRef="Task_SendTicketEmail" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Ticket_SMS" name="Send ticket by SMS" sourceRef="Task_SendTicketSMS" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reminder" name="Send pre-travel reminders and instructions" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReminder" messageRef="Message_Reminder"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ticket journey" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Customer" name="Begin ticket search"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Search" name="Search for a flight, train, or bus ticket"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Select" name="Select route, date, and time"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitDetails" name="Provide personal information and payment details" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTicket" name="Receive ticket" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderDecision" name="Will reminders be received?" default="Flow_Customer_NoReminder"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveReminder" name="Receive pre-travel reminders and instructions" messageRef="Message_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderMerge" name="Continue after reminder decision"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteJourney" name="Complete the journey"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostTravelDecision" name="Will post-travel feedback or services extend the process?" default="Flow_PostTravel_NoExtension"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostTravel" name="Engage in post-travel feedback or services"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Journey" name="Journey completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PostTravel" name="Post-travel extension completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Start_Search" sourceRef="StartEvent_Customer" targetRef="Task_Search"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Search_Select" sourceRef="Task_Search" targetRef="Task_Select"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Select_Submit" sourceRef="Task_Select" targetRef="Task_SubmitDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Submit_Ticket" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Ticket_ReminderDecision" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_ReminderYes" name="Reminder received" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReminder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">reminderSent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_NoReminder" name="No reminder" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_ReminderReceived" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveReminder" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_ReminderMerge_Journey" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge" targetRef="Task_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Journey_PostTravelDecision" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Gateway_PostTravelDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel_Extension" name="Post-travel feedback or services" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravelDecision" targetRef="Task_PostTravel">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">postTravelExtension</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel_NoExtension" name="No extension" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravelDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_Journey"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel_End" sourceRef="Task_PostTravel" targetRef="EndEvent_PostTravel"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Travel company ticket processing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BookingReceived" name="Booking details received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BookingReceived" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TicketChannel" name="Choose ticket delivery channel" default="Flow_Ticket_SMS"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicketEmail" name="Send ticket by email" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicketSMS" name="Send ticket by SMS" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TicketChannelMerge" name="Continue after ticket delivery"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderSendDecision" name="Send pre-travel reminders and instructions?" default="Flow_NoReminderSend"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReminder" name="Send pre-travel reminders and instructions" messageRef="Message_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CompanyReminderSent" name="Reminders sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CompanyNoReminder" name="Ticket processing completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_Start_Generate" sourceRef="StartEvent_BookingReceived" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Generate_TicketChannel" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Gateway_TicketChannel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ticket_Email" name="Email" sourceRef="Gateway_TicketChannel" targetRef="Task_SendTicketEmail">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">deliveryChannel = "email"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ticket_SMS" name="SMS" sourceRef="Gateway_TicketChannel" targetRef="Task_SendTicketSMS"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_TicketMerge" sourceRef="Task_SendTicketEmail" targetRef="Gateway_TicketChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SMS_TicketMerge" sourceRef="Task_SendTicketSMS" targetRef="Gateway_TicketChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TicketMerge_Inventory" sourceRef="Gateway_TicketChannelMerge" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inventory_ReminderDecision" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderSendDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendReminder" name="Send reminders" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderSendDecision" targetRef="Task_SendReminder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">remindersApplicable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoReminderSend" name="No reminders" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderSendDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_CompanyNoReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReminderSent_End" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="EndEvent_CompanyReminderSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_TicketBooking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/ticket-booking">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Submit_Ticket" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Ticket_Reminder" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_Received" name="Reminders received" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_No_Reminder" name="No reminders" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderSplit" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveReminder" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_To_Journey" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge" targetRef="Task_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Journey_PostTravel" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Gateway_PostTravelSplit"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Ticket generation and inventory update" isExecutable="false">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_TicketBooking"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BookingDetails" name="Personal information and payment details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Reminder" name="Pre-travel reminders and check-in or boarding instructions"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel company" processRef="Process_TravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BookingDetails"
                      name="Submit personal information and payment details"
                      sourceRef="Task_SubmitDetails"
                      targetRef="StartEvent_BookingReceived"
                      messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Ticket"
                      name="Send ticket via email or SMS"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendTicket"
                      targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket"
                      messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reminder"
                      name="Send pre-travel reminders and instructions"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendReminder"
                      targetRef="StartEvent_ReminderReceived"
                      messageRef="Message_Reminder"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ticket journey" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Customer" name="Ticket search initiated"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Search" name="Search for a flight, train, or bus ticket"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Select" name="Select preferred route, date, and time"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitDetails"
                   name="Provide personal information and payment details"
                   messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTicket" name="Receive ticket" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteJourney" name="Complete the journey"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostTravel" name="Post-travel extension?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostTravel" name="Provide post-travel feedback or use post-travel services"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PostTravelCompleted" name="Post-travel feedback or services completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Start_Search" sourceRef="StartEvent_Customer" targetRef="Task_Search"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Search_Select" sourceRef="Task_Search" targetRef="Task_Select"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Select_Submit" sourceRef="Task_Select" targetRef="Task_SubmitDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Submit_ReceiveTicket" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_ReceiveTicket_Journey" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" targetRef="Task_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Journey_PostTravel" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Gateway_PostTravel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel_NoExtension"
                       name="No post-travel extension"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravel"
                       targetRef="EndEvent_JourneyCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel_Extension"
                       name="Post-travel feedback or services"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravel"
                       targetRef="Task_PostTravel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel_Complete" sourceRef="Task_PostTravel" targetRef="EndEvent_PostTravelCompleted"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_ReceiveReminder"
                     name="Receive pre-travel reminders and instructions"
                     triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ReminderReceived"
                       name="Pre-travel reminders and check-in or boarding instructions received"
                       isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReminderReceived" messageRef="Message_Reminder"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReminderReceived" name="Reminder received"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReminderReceived_End"
                         sourceRef="StartEvent_ReminderReceived"
                         targetRef="EndEvent_ReminderReceived"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Ticket booking and inventory" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_TravelCompany">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BookingSystem" name="Booking system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_BookingReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_TravelCompany" name="Travel company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateInventory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReminderDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendReminder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReminderMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_CompanyCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BookingReceived" name="Booking details received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BookingReceived" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicket" name="Send generated ticket via email or SMS" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory accordingly"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderDecision"
                           name="Send pre-travel reminders and instructions?"
                           default="Flow_NoReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReminder"
                   name="Send pre-travel reminders and check-in or boarding instructions"
                   messageRef="Message_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderMerge" name="Continue after reminder decision"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CompanyCompleted" name="Booking and inventory processing completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_Start_Generate" sourceRef="StartEvent_BookingReceived" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_Generate_Send" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Task_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_Send_Inventory" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_Inventory_ReminderDecision" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendReminder"
                       name="Send reminders and instructions"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderDecision"
                       targetRef="Task_SendReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoReminder"
                       name="No reminders"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderDecision"
                       targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_Merge" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReminderMerge_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_CompanyCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_TicketBooking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BookingDetails" name="Personal information and payment details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking">

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ticket journey" isExecutable="false">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Customer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectRoute</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReminderSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveReminder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReminderMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteJourney</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostTravelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_JourneyCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_PostTravelCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Customer" name="Begin ticket search"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Search" name="Search for a flight, train, or bus ticket"/>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTicket" name="Receive ticket" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderSplit" name="Receive a pre-travel reminder?"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveReminder" name="Receive pre-travel reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Message_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderMerge" name="Continue after optional reminder"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteJourney" name="Complete the travel journey"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostTravelSplit" name="Continue with optional post-travel feedback or services?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostTravel" name="Provide post-travel feedback or use post-travel services"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PostTravelCompleted" name="Post-travel extension completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Start_Search" sourceRef="StartEvent_Customer" targetRef="Task_Search"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Search_Select" sourceRef="Task_Search" targetRef="Task_SelectRoute"/>

rules.instruction: When the description names an activity or outcome with multiple stated actions, alternatives, or a distinguishing object or participant.: Label the corresponding BPMN activity or event so its described scope remains identifiable.
